r.경제 체제: Economy tied to South Africa · water, electricity and clothing exports
r.생활 물가 수준: 35% of the US level (2025, World Bank, household consumption at purchasing power parity against the market exchange rate)
r.주요 수출품: Diamonds 24%, Beverages 19%, Clothing (knit) 17%, Clothing (woven) 13%, Wool 5% (2024, share of all exports, top 5)

r.한국이 사는 것: Electronics, electrical equipment 100% (2025, share of value)

t.why: It sells water to South Africa, and many of its people work there.
t.rel: A mountain kingdom completely surrounded by South Africa. It sells water to South Africa, and many of its people work there.
t.know: The only country whose entire territory lies above 1,000 m.
t.etext: Surrounded by South Africa, it sells water and electricity to its neighbor and exports diamonds and clothing. It depends heavily on the South African economy.
